name: team-manager
description: Orchestrates virtual agent teams by managing handoffs and delegation.

handoff_to.description: Switches the current Prometheus persona to a specialized role. Calling this tool will immediately yield control to the next agent autonomously.

role.description: The name of the role to switch to (e.g., 'team-architect', 'team-coder').

context.description: The specific context or requirements to pass to the next agent.

delegate_task.description: Assigns a task to a specific role without switching immediately.

get_team_status.description: Provides a summary of each role's current focus and progress.

monitor_resources.description: Checks system resources (RAM) to decide on concurrency.

set_task_timer.description: Sets a timeout for a task to prevent infinite loops or hanging.

escalate_to_9b.description: Signals that the current task requires a larger model (9B).

save_plan.description: Parses a user's multi-step plan and saves it persistently. Each step MUST include a task description and the expected assignee role.

assignee.description: The target role for this step (e.g., 'team-coder', 'team-researcher').

plan_steps.description: An array of objects representing the steps of the plan, each with a numeric ID, task description, and target role.

get_next_step.description: Reads the persistent plan to retrieve the next incomplete step.

mark_step_done.description: Marks a plan step as completed or failed so the PM can move on.

step_id.description: The numeric ID of the step to update.

result.description: A brief summary of what happened during the step.
